meta.title: Stone Soup
meta.textType: story: a traditional tale about sharing

paragraphs: On Thursday, August twenty-seventh, Chef Lucy visited the school canteen. She cooked with the Explorers at one o'clock. Before they cooked, Lily, Mia, Leo, and May washed their hands. Teacher Kim watched from a chair. A big silver pot stood on the stove. "Today we make soup, and I know a good recipe," said Chef Lucy. Every ingredient was ready on the table. Lily and Mia sliced the carrots, and Leo and May held the green beans. "After the water boils, we add the vegetables," said Chef Lucy. "Before that, I will tell you the story of Stone Soup."

Three hungry travelers came to a village. They had bags, but they had no food. The travelers were tired and hungry. They came to a door, and a woman looked out. No one in the village wanted to share. The travelers put a clean stone in a pot of water. "We are making stone soup," they said. The woman came to look. "Soup from a stone?" she asked. "Yes," said a traveler, "but it needs salt." The woman brought salt. Then a man brought vegetables, and a girl brought noodles. After the soup boiled, everyone in the village ate it together.

Now the water in the big pot boiled. The children added the vegetables, the salt, and the noodles. "What else does a good soup need?" asked Chef Lucy. "Pepper!" said Mia. Chef Lucy put some pepper in the pot. Then everyone smelled the soup. It smelled wonderful. They sat at a long table with bowls and spoons. Chef Lucy tasted the soup first. "This is a good meal for everyone," she said. Leo said, "I like soup with noodles!" Mia said, "I don't like onions, but I like this soup." Lily asked, "Was there really a stone in the soup?" Chef Lucy laughed and held up a clean gray stone on a plate. "Not in ours!" she said.
Teacher Kim ate a bowl of soup. "The soup is good because we all helped," she said. The children washed the bowls before they went home.
text.summary: Chef Lucy cooks soup with the club and tells the old tale of Stone Soup. In the tale, three travelers make a whole village share food.
